name: blockbench-mcp-pro
description: 最完善的 Blockbench MCP —— 插件内进程 HTTP(S) MCP + stdio 网关双通道

scripts.build: cd packages/shared && npm run build && cd ../plugin && npm run build && cd ../../gateway && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: cd packages/shared && npm run typecheck && cd ../plugin && npm run typecheck && cd ../../gateway && npm run typecheck
scripts.test:unit: cd packages/shared && npm test && cd ../plugin && npm test && cd ../../gateway && npm test
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
